title: Candidate evaluation before and after key redesign
method: Synthetic key condition selects 1,000 items and a filter returns 20, or 2%. A redesigned key/index condition selects 20, reducing candidate evaluation 50×. Actual read capacity depends on item size, consistency and request boundaries; this is not a billed-cost estimate.
alt: Candidate evaluation before and after key redesign. Broad key candidates: 1000 items; Returned after filter: 20 items; Selective key candidates: 20 items. Illustrative values.
